messages.content:
Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Please review `doc_helio_start_pricing_refresh_2028` and post a focused preflight comment identifying the established instrumentation prerequisites and pricing-page change restriction that must be satisfied before this proposal proceeds. Do not approve the proposal or claim that any prerequisite has already been completed.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "post_doc_comment", "arguments": {"doc_id": "doc_helio_start_pricing_refresh_2028", "body": "Preflight — prerequisites and restriction (not an approval)

Before this proposal proceeds, the established instrumentation gate must be satisfied: event taxonomy and entitlement instrumentation must consistently capture admin/permissions complexity, import or migration help required, support-handoff requirement, and entitlement state, including relevant exceptions and boundary conditions. The measurement must distinguish self-serve-eligible cases from assisted or refusal-risk cases and provide a reliable performance read.

Pricing-page restriction: while pricing is under test, no other layout or UI changes may ship on the tested page. Copy/content changes are permitted only if they do not move page elements or otherwise confound the run. This proposal should not advance until the gate and sequencing restriction are explicitly satisfied; this comment does not attest that either has been completed."}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_158_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The comment identifies as prerequisites before any Helio Start pricing-page experiment or launch both clean event taxonomy and entitlement instrumentation covering all four required areas: admin complexity, import or migration help, support handoff, and entitlement state. Missing any area or treating the instrumentation as optional must fail.

The comment states that no other layout or UI changes may run or ship on the pricing page concurrently with the pricing experiment or its measurement window. Generic advice to minimize changes is insufficient; the restriction must be presented as a governing rule.

The comment does not approve the proposal and does not claim or imply that the required instrumentation or restriction checks are already complete.
